shortDescription: Reaction-arm-free bolting interfaces with wedge-locking protection against vibration-induced self-loosening.
longDescription: ToughTorq Reaction Washers combine a gear-shaped lower washer with a matched dual socket so torque reaction is contained coaxially at the fastener instead of through an external reaction arm. The wedge-locking washer pair helps preserve preload under vibration and dynamic loading while reducing reaction-arm pinch points and surface-contact requirements.
features: Reaction-arm-free tightening with a matched dual socket
Torque applied axially without an additional bending moment
Low friction variation supports controlled tightening
Matched socket and adaptor configurations for powered torque tools

operatingRequirements.label: Fastener Strength
operatingRequirements.value: Suitable for high-strength bolts through property class 12.9 and nuts through class 12

operatingRequirements.label: Tool Interface
operatingRequirements.value: Use a matched dual socket and application-specific adaptor for the selected electric, pneumatic, or hydraulic torque tool

compatibility: The dual socket must match both the torque tool drive/interface and the selected Reaction Washer size.
Published Reaction Washer sizes cover M16–M48 (5/8–1-3/4 in); additional nominal sizes, materials, and coatings are available on request.
For through-bolt joints where the passive side cannot be counter-held, an optional passive-side safety washer may be used.

componentGroups.description: Gear-shaped wedge-locking washer system that provides the coaxial reaction interface and helps maintain preload under vibration.

specifications.designPrinciple: Wedge-locking anti-loosening system designed in accordance with DIN 25201 principles
specifications.corrosionResistance: Minimum 1,000 hours NSS testing to ISO 9227

sourceReference: ToughTorq Reaction Washers technical data brochure

componentGroups.description: Coaxial socket system that engages the fastener and the gear-shaped Reaction Washer profile so reaction torque is contained at the joint.

specifications.compatibility: Matched configurations available for common powered torque tools

sourceReference: ToughTorq Reaction Washers technical data brochure

componentGroups.description: Friction-based backup washer for through-bolt connections where the passive-side nut or bolt head cannot be physically counter-held.

specifications.function: Wave-shaped locking ribs on both faces resist passive-side rotation during tightening
